sentences.en: Juha once sat in a court.

sentences.ar: הוא היה השופט של אותו יום.
sentences.en: He was the judge of that day.
Two men came in and shouted.
The first told the whole story.

sentences.ar: הוא סיפר על עז ועל שדה.
sentences.en: He told about a goat and about a field.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: העז אכלה את הכול.
sentences.en: He said: the goat ate everything.
Juha listened and thought a moment.
He said: you are completely right.

sentences.ar: השני קם ואמר: תשמע גם אותי.
sentences.en: The second got up and said: hear me too.
He told about a broken fence.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הוא לא תיקן אותה.
sentences.en: He said: he did not repair it.
Juha said: you are right too.
His wife sat in the corner and heard.

sentences.ar: היא אמרה: זה לא יכול להיות.
היא אמרה: שניים לא צודקים יחד.
sentences.en: She said: two are not right together.
Juha looked at her and said: true.
He said: and you are right too.
